chat.youMsg: I want to speak English more confidently, but I’m not sure what to say.
chat.botMsg: Great — tell me about your day in 5 sentences. I’ll help you sound more natural.
chat.tipMsg: Try: “I’d like to practice speaking every day — even 10 minutes helps.”

chatDemo.userTranscriptText: Mañana tengo una entrevista de trabajo para un puesto de Product Manager. ¿Qué puedo decir cuando me pregunten: «¿Por qué deberíamos contratarte?»
chatDemo.userTranscriptTranslation: Tomorrow I have a job interview for a Product Manager role. What can I say when they ask, "Why should we hire you?"
chatDemo.botTranscriptText: Buena pregunta. Mantenlo breve y concreto: conecta tu experiencia con resultados y termina con seguridad. ¿Qué logro con impacto medible puedes mencionar?
chatDemo.botTranscriptTranslation: Good question. Keep it short and concrete: connect your experience to results, then end with confidence. What is one achievement with a measurable impact you can mention?
chatDemo.hintsIntro: Here are a few options for your next reply:
chatDemo.question: ¿Qué logro con impacto medible puedes mencionar?
chatDemo.questionBase: What is one achievement with a measurable impact you can mention?
chatDemo.simple: En mi último puesto, mejoré el onboarding y reduje el abandono en un 12%.
chatDemo.simpleBase: In my last role, I improved onboarding and reduced drop-off by 12%.
chatDemo.conversational: Me enfoco en convertir procesos desordenados en pasos claros, y eso ayudó a nuestro equipo a reducir el abandono del onboarding en un 12%.
chatDemo.conversationalBase: I focus on turning messy processes into clear steps, and that helped our team cut onboarding drop-off by 12%.
chatDemo.advanced: Combino pensamiento de producto con ejecución: identifiqué puntos de fricción, alineé al equipo en prioridades y aplicamos cambios que mejoraron la retención en onboarding en un 12%.
chatDemo.advancedBase: I combine product thinking with execution: I mapped friction points, aligned the team on priorities, and we delivered changes that improved onboarding retention by 12%.
chatDemo.phraseOne: Puedo aportar valor desde el primer día.
chatDemo.phraseOneBase: I can add value from day one.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subhead: Everything you need to know before you start practicing.

items.q: How does the Telegram language learning bot work?
items.a: You send a short voice or text message in Telegram, the bot analyzes it, and you receive a corrected, more natural reply plus practical feedback.

items.q: Does it adapt to my language level?
items.a: Yes. You can choose your level (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1), and correction depth adapts so feedback stays useful and not overwhelming.

items.q: Can I practice without booking live lessons?
items.a: Yes. Practice is fully asynchronous in Telegram, so you can train whenever you have a free moment.

items.q: Can I get translation and reply suggestions?
items.a: Yes. Each response can include translation support and follow-up hint options to help you answer faster and keep the conversation moving.

items.q: Does the bot remember my progress?
items.a: Yes. The bot keeps your level and conversation context, so your practice stays personalized over time.
Yes. You can start with a free plan and upgrade when you want more weekly practice volume.
